items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: it was an old comedy team years ago, comedian named John Mason. He was a funny man.

ctx.x: Physical, oh, gee whiz. You know, it's like the -- it was an old comedy team years ago, comedian named John Mason. He was a funny man. He said he never did like the farm because there were too many "ups" on it. You get up every morning -- he wasn't kidding. It was a hard job. But I had to hoe the garden, I had to plow, had to feed chickens. Oh, there's so much work to do.
Bad it was, it might have been a good thing because physically you stayed in remarkable shape.
